name: Mito Ikumi
source: Ikumi Mito is a 92nd Tōtsuki Generation student and a member of the Don RS. Previously an associate of Erina Nakiri, Ikumi was a rival of Sōma Yukihira until she lost a Shokugeki to him. She became an ally to Sōma following the duel.
